name: compact-plus
description: Preserve Claude Code session state before and after context compaction: transcript backup, LLM-generated state files, warn-threshold reminders, and post-compact recovery guidance. Ported from u-ichi/compact-plus (MIT).

interface.longDescription: Back up the transcript and generate a structured state file before context compaction, then inject recovery guidance afterwards. In Codex, the compact-plus skill serves as the manual pre-compaction state-save fallback.
defaultPrompt: Save the session state before compaction
